title: polyEval's recursive unfolding: one more Horner step
statement: For any c, n, x: polyEval c (n+1) x = polyEval c n x + c(n)*x^n -- the recursive unfolding of Horner evaluation by one more term, proved by Eq.refl and registered as a first-class named equation.

formal.statement: theorem Complex.polyEval_succ : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Complex)) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : Complex) -> Eq.{1} Complex (Complex.polyEval x0 (AxNat.succ x1) x2) (Complex.add (Complex.polyEval x0 x1 x2) (Complex.mul (x0 x1) (Complex.pow x2 x1))))))
